title: PET-184 per-dispatch metadata (<stem>.meta.json)
description: The completion sentinel and the audit record. Written after the process exits (codex) or after the HTTP call returns (http), or synthesized by the resume path for an orphan. manifest.py enumerates dispatches by these files. This file is the single authority for the meta field set; the spec references it and does not restate it.

area.description: Carried here, not only in the reviewer's response body: a dispatch that fails before producing a schema-valid response still has to be attributable to an area, or the coverage floor's whole-area clause cannot be evaluated.

units.description: The attempts.json keys this dispatch charges.

exit.description: INTEGER or null, never a string. null means the resume path could not observe it (orphaned) -- see orphaned/timed_out/killed_by for the reason. Decision 4's rules compare it numerically.

timed_out.description: Both kinds. http: set when the WebException status is Timeout, so a deadline expiry is distinguishable from a dropped socket (both would otherwise read 599).

orphaned.description: true when this file was synthesized by the resume path from the marker rather than written by the launching shell.

killed_by.description: Present only on the orchestrator-side kill record, which is written to <stem>.meta.killed.json -- a separate path, so a revived launching shell cannot overwrite it.

seconds.description: Wall-clock. null for an orphan: no shell observed it.

dispatched_at.description: ISO 8601 round-trip ('o'). Never PowerShell's default /Date(ms)/ serialization, which no standard parser reads.

http_status.description: http only. 599 means transport error ONLY; a real HTTP status is recovered from the exception. null on an orphan-synthesized record, where no shell observed the response.

finish_reason.description: http only. THE discriminator between a truncated response and a refusal, both of which present as 200-with-empty-content. Measured live against LM Studio: max_tokens=64 on a thinking model gives finish_reason='length' with 64/64 tokens spent on reasoning and zero content; the same call at 512 gives 'stop' with real content. Without this field the classifier reads a token-budget truncation as a safety refusal.

reasoning_tokens.description: http only, from usage.completion_tokens_details. Records how much of the budget the model spent thinking, so a 'length' finish is diagnosable rather than mysterious.

max_tokens.description: http only. The completion budget sent as max_tokens; null when unset. Exists because the configured fallback is a thinking model that, unbudgeted, spent 32,474 reasoning tokens returning zero content.

reasoning_max_tokens.description: http only. The reasoning budget sent as reasoning.max_tokens (OpenRouter convention); null when unset.
